## Social Fetch - Instagram

Sub-workflow. Called by **Social Daily Report - Orchestrator**.

Input: `account_id`, `channel`, `likes_label`, `days`

Output: one item per Reel / Video, using the standard schema:
`platform, channel, id, title, views, likes, comments, permalink`

Token: credential **Facebook Graph account** (use a System User token so it never expires).
